facts.claim: Seating is first come, first served. Confirm any seating accommodation you need before buying tickets.
facts.quote: Seating is first come first serve.

facts.claim: The official directions locate the club around the back of Market Place. The step-free route from parking to the entrance has not yet been verified.
facts.quote: We are tucked away around the back of Market Place in wonderful Montgomery.

facts.claim: The official homepage publishes a new telephone number, 513-873-7233. Use the current official contact details when asking about access arrangements.

The November 12–14 and November 19–21, 2026 listings give doors at 6:30 p.m. for 7:30 shows and 9:20 p.m. for 9:45 shows. These are event-specific times; check the selected show. First-come seating does not guarantee a particular seat or an accommodation.
quote: Claire Sundbye November 12 - 14 (click for more info) Doors open at 6:30 for 7:30 shows and 9:20 for 9:45 shows. Seating is first come first serve.
Kevin Bozeman November 19 - 21 (click for more info) Doors open at 6:30 for 7:30 shows and 9:20 for 9:45 shows. Seating is first come first serve.

facts.claim: The Bengals’ June 30, 2026 construction notice says Lot 1 and Lot A have reduced game-day capacity for 2026 and the duration of the Brent Spence bridge project. Affected passholders should check their updated lot in Bengals Account Manager; members with questions can call 513-621-8383. The notice does not establish a step-free route from a replacement lot.
quote: For 2026 and through the duration of the project, Lot 1 and Lot A will experience capacity reductions for Bengals gamedays.
Those with parking passes in Lot 1 or Lot A are encouraged to log in to their Bengals Account Manager to view their updated parking locations.
Members with questions are encouraged to contact their Membership Reps or call 513-621-8383.

facts.claim: The July 21, 2026 renovation report described passenger-elevator modernization as ongoing. It does not identify affected elevators, outages or completion dates; check the route needed for your ticket before visiting. This is a dated construction report, not a live elevator-status notice.
facts.quote: Essential infrastructure work is ongoing, including concrete repairs, waterproofing, and passenger elevator modernization, to help ensure the stadium remains in top condition.
